mcu: SPC560B64L7 / MPC5607B, PowerPC e200z0h, big-endian VLE

method.loader: OEM SBL DV6T-14C097-AB with an appended seventh SRAM block at 0x40006000
method.transport: raw CAN0 id 0x5A5, records of [address:u32-be][data:u32], completion marker FFFFFFFF#444F4E45
method.validation: every chunk required full address coverage, a DONE marker, zero rejected records and zero conflicting duplicates

regions.description: code flash (PBL, calibration, application, remaining physical CFlash)

notes: Region bounds follow RM0037 Rev 10 user CFlash/shadow/DFlash ranges.
TestFlash and reserved/OTP areas were deliberately not read.
Each file is a flat image; file offset 0 corresponds to the region start address.
The recovered calibration region is byte-identical to JV6T-14C095-AB.
The recovered application differs from OEM JV6T-14C094-AD in five bytes (four configuration bytes plus the internal checksum byte); the as-read module content is preserved here.

independent_verification.calibration_vs_JV6T-14C095-AB: block @0x00C000 len 0x4000 is byte-identical (0 differing bytes)
independent_verification.application_vs_JV6T-14C094-AD: differs in 4 configuration bytes at 0x017CAD, 0x017CAE, 0x017CAF and 0x017CBB, plus the internal checksum byte at 0x13FFFF
independent_verification.internal_sum8: stored word @0x13FFFE is 0x75A5 and equals the recomputed sum of bytes 0x10000..0x13FFFE; guard word @0x13FFFC is 0xFFFF
independent_verification.self_consistency: the captured configuration bytes sum to +51 relative to OEM -AD and the stored checksum is likewise +51 (0x75A5 vs 0x7572), so the image satisfies the firmware's own integrity algorithm
